summary: A Claude or Codex profile switch compares the transcripts again when only the stopped source session wrote a late record, instead of failing with a context conflict on the first try.

desktop.reason: No renderer change. The existing conflict dialog simply stops appearing for this case.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone asks the backend to switch; the retry runs in the backend, so the phone gets the fix with no change.

nativeAndroid.reason: Same as React Native: the retry is backend-side.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema or stored data change. A target that changes still aborts without being overwritten.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop release; no wire or protocol change.

automated: tests/unit/transcript-compatibility.test.ts: a source that appends one late record is compared again and copied; a source that keeps changing gives up after 3 attempts; a target that changes still aborts. Both new tests fail without the fix.
hardware: Diagnosed from the packaged app log and the real transcript: the stopped Claude CLI appended a background-task notification about 2 s after stop, between the two compares.
notExercised: The fixed switch has not been clicked in a packaged build yet.
